records.title: SlotVLA: Towards Modeling of Object-Relation Representations in Robotic Manipulation
records.reason: SlotVLA models object-relation representations for robotic manipulation. Its experiments target action/representation quality rather than LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
records.reason: Dream-RSI studies recursive self-improvement in evolving simulated worlds. Its full text centers on agent/environment learning, not efficient LLM serving.

records.title: Zetta $\zeta$: An Efficient Closed-Loop Embodied Harness for Self-Evolving Physical Intelligence
records.reason: Zetta presents an efficient closed-loop embodied harness with latency/throughput constraints for physical intelligence. It is robotics infrastructure rather than LLM serving, but its closed-loop scheduling/runtime design may transfer.

records.title: Staying VIGILant: Mitigating Visual Laziness via Counterfactual Visual Alignment in MLLMs
records.reason: VIGILant mitigates visual laziness in multimodal LLMs through counterfactual visual alignment. The method improves visual grounding; it is not presented as a compute or latency reduction, so the connection to inference efficiency is indirect.

records.title: Automated Benchmark Auditing for AI Agents and Large Language Models
records.reason: Automated Benchmark Auditing evaluates benchmark integrity for AI agents/LLMs. Its target is audit reliability, not inference systems.
